sourceSignatureHeader.title: Signature
sourceSignatureHeader.description: Specify the location to find the Signature (typically from a HTTP header, and in Base64) (Supports EL)

schemeType.title: Validation Type
schemeType.description: By default, this policy will validate the signature only against the HTTP body.  Change this option if you need to include additional headers (as well as the HTTP body) in the signature validation.

oneOf.title: HTTP Body (only)
oneOf.description: By default, this policy will validate the signature only against the HTTP body.

oneOf.title: HTTP Body + Header(s)
oneOf.description: Validate the signature using both the HTTP body, pre-fixed with additional header(s)

headersDelimiter.title: Delimiter
headersDelimiter.description: Specify the delimiter used to separate each header and the body (must match the delimiter used to generate the signature)

headers.title: HTTP Headers
headers.description: List of headers to use in Webhook signature validation

timestampValidity.title: Replay Protection
timestampValidity.description: Optionally require a signed timestamp header and reject the request if it is missing, malformed, or outside the allowed age/clock skew (protects against replayed requests).

oneOf.title: Enabled
oneOf.description: Require a timestamp header, include it in the recomputed HMAC, and reject stale or replayed requests.

sourceTimestampHeader.title: Timestamp Header
sourceTimestampHeader.description: Specify the HTTP header that contains the timestamp (epoch seconds) generated by the Webhook Signature Generator policy

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Specify the delimiter used to separate the timestamp from the rest of the signed content (must match the delimiter used to generate the signature)

maxSignatureAge.title: Max Age (seconds)
maxSignatureAge.description: Reject the request if the timestamp is older than this many seconds (replay protection)

clockSkew.title: Clock Skew Tolerance (seconds)
clockSkew.description: Reject the request if the timestamp is further ahead of the gateway's clock than this many seconds

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The secret key used to sign (supports EL)
